verdict.rationale: AgentMail is a developer API for provisioning and operating new email inboxes for AI agents, not a personal multi-account client for consolidating existing Gmail/Microsoft 365/IMAP accounts. Its IMAP/SMTP feature runs the opposite direction — letting external clients connect INTO an AgentMail-created inbox — not aggregating a switcher's pre-existing provider accounts into one interface, so the 'switcher consolidating accounts' story is a category mismatch for this product.
